description:
Return the DNS records to create in Cloudflare for this site, INCLUDING the
    DNS-AID SVCB/HTTPS records (RFC 9460). Read-only / plan-only in v1 - you
    create them in CF (or a later tool with a scoped token will). Enable DNSSEC on
    the zone so validating resolvers get authenticated data.
name: cloudflare_plan
